hero.caption: The Karlevi runestone (Öl 1, RAÄ No Vickleby 10:1) is the longest runic inscription on Öland. It is situated in Vickleby parish, Mörbylånga municipality, Öland, Kalamar county, Sweden.
hero.alt: The Karlevi runestone (Öl 1, RAÄ No Vickleby 10:1) is the longest runic inscription on Öland. It is situated in Vickleby parish, Mörbylånga municipality, Öland, Kalamar county, Sweden.
